ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 1:1 ratio of high-intensity white pixels to low-intensity black pixels across the visible ventral surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Bilateral white pigmentation fields located in the mid-lobe regions, partitioned by a wide black central vertical band and enclosed by thick black trailing edge borders with internal black circular mottling.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped central depression with an approximate interior angle of 65 degrees and a high depth-to-width ratio relative to the lobe junction.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency serration pattern with irregular peak heights; prominent deep U-shaped notches localized on the right lobe trailing edge.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex sweep on distal margins transitioning to concave curves leading into the medial notch area.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Dense clusters of circular white-on-black pixel rings at the lateral tips; scattered black-on-white circular rings distributed across both primary white pigmentation zones.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Group of 3-4 parallel diagonal white lines on the left lobe; multiple intersecting fine linear scratches and rake marks on the black medial surface.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Significant jagged indentation on the inner portion of the right lobe trailing edge; multiple high-relief calcified protrusions along the distal margins.
other_distinctive_markers: A prominent dark circular focal point located in the upper-mid region of the right lobe white pigmentation area.
